segments.an4.158:1.1: Tatra kho āyasmā sāriputto bhikkhū āmantesi –
segments.an4.158:1.3: “Āvuso”ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato sāriputtassa paccassosuṃ.
segments.an4.158:2.1: “Yo hi koci, āvuso, bhikkhu vā bhikkhunī vā cattāro dhamme attani samanupassati, niṭṭhamettha gantabbaṃ –
segments.an4.158:2.5: Rāgavepullattaṃ [rāgavepullataṃ (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)], dosavepullattaṃ, mohavepullattaṃ, gambhīresu kho panassa ṭhānāṭhānesu paññācakkhu na kamati.
segments.an4.158:2.6: Yo hi koci, āvuso, bhikkhu vā bhikkhunī vā ime cattāro dhamme attani samanupassati, niṭṭhamettha gantabbaṃ –
segments.an4.158:3.1: “Yo hi koci, āvuso, bhikkhu vā bhikkhunī vā cattāro dhamme attani samanupassati, niṭṭhamettha gantabbaṃ –
segments.an4.158:3.5: Rāgatanuttaṃ [rāgatanuttanaṃ (ka.)], dosatanuttaṃ, mohatanuttaṃ, gambhīresu kho panassa ṭhānāṭhānesu paññācakkhu kamati.
segments.an4.158:3.6: Yo hi koci, āvuso, bhikkhu vā bhikkhunī vā ime cattāro dhamme attani samanupassati, niṭṭhamettha gantabbaṃ –
